::: {.callout-note title="Summative Inquiry Prompt 总结性评估核心探究问题" icon=false}
**"To what extent did Classical Mediterranean systems of governance represent progress given their continuous dependence on slavery?"**

“鉴于古典地中海文明对奴隶制度的持续依赖，其治理体系在多大程度上代表了人类社会的进步？”

**Historical Scope 历史范围说明:** Focus primarily on Classical Greece (Athenian {{< vocab "democracy" zh=true >}} / Spartan oligarchy) and/or Ancient Rome ({{< vocab "republic" zh=true >}} / Twelve Tables). You may optionally reference River Valley Civilizations (Mesopotamia / Egypt) as a historical baseline to measure "progress."
重点分析古典希腊（雅典民主制/斯巴达寡头制）和/或古罗马（共和国/《十二铜表法》）。你可以选择性地引用大河文明（美索不达米亚/古埃及）作为衡量“进步”的历史基准。
:::

**Target Essay Pathway 论文写作路径（二选一）:**

☐ **Standard Path 标准路径 (4 Paragraphs 四段式):** Intro 引言 + Body 1 治理进步 + Body 2 奴隶制局限 + Conclusion 结论\
☐ **Advanced Path 进阶路径 (5 Paragraphs 五段式):** Adds Body 3 Counter-Claim & Rebuttal 增加第三主体段“反方观点与批驳”

# Step 1 (Lesson 1): Prompt Breakdown, Thesis & Research Plan 步骤一（第1课时）：审题拆解、中心论点与研究计划

::: {.callout-tip title="Essential Bilingual Academic Vocabulary Bank 核心双语学术词汇库（写作高频词）" icon=false}
- **MYP Command Terms 核心指令词:** {{< vocab "formulate" zh=true >}} · {{< vocab "investigate" zh=true >}} · {{< vocab "analyse" text="analyze" zh=true >}} · {{< vocab "evaluate" zh=true >}} · {{< vocab "explain" zh=true >}} · {{< vocab "justify" zh=true >}} · {{< vocab "synthesize" zh=true >}} · {{< vocab "document" zh=true >}} · {{< vocab "reflect" zh=true >}}
- **Governance & Law 治理与法律:** direct {{< vocab "democracy" zh=true >}} 直接民主制 | {{< vocab "citizen" zh=true >}} {{< vocab "assembly" zh=true >}} | oligarchy 寡头政治 | {{< vocab "republic" zh=true >}} | checks and balances 权力制衡 | {{< vocab "senate" zh=true >}} | {{< vocab "consul" text="consuls" zh=true >}} | tribunes 保民官 | **Twelve Tables** 《十二铜表法》 | **due process** 正当法律程序 | legal equality 法律面前公民平等
- **Slavery & Hierarchy 奴隶制与等级控制:** **chattel slavery** 动产奴隶制（把人视为财产） | continuous dependence 持续依赖 | helots 希洛人（斯巴达国有奴隶） | **latifundia** 古罗马大奴隶制庄园 | gladiators 角斗士 | systemic exploitation 系统性剥削 | disenfranchisement 剥夺政治权利 | **civic exclusion** 公民权排斥（女性、奴隶、外邦人）
:::

## Step 1.1: Deconstructing the Summative Prompt | 步骤 1.1：拆解总结性评估题目

::: {.write-in}
| Prompt Key Phrase 题目关键词句 | Guiding Questions (Bilingual) 思考引导问题（双语） | My Initial Brainstorm & Examples 我的初步思路与历史例证 |
|---|---|---|
| **1. "To what extent…"**<br>“在多大程度上……” | How much real progress was achieved? Was it major progress, partial/limited progress, or progress only for a privileged minority?<br>究竟实现了多少真正的进步？是巨大的进步、部分的/有限的进步，还是仅仅属于少数特权公民的进步？ | {{< lines 3 >}} |
| **2. "…Classical Mediterranean systems of governance represent progress…"**<br>“……古典地中海治理体系代表了进步……” | Which system(s) will you {{< vocab "analyse" text="analyze" zh=true >}} (Athenian Democracy, Spartan Oligarchy, Roman Republic & Twelve Tables)? How did voting, checks & balances, or written law protect citizens?<br>你将分析哪些制度（雅典民主、斯巴达寡头、罗马共和与《十二铜表法》）？公民投票、权力制衡或成文法如何保障公民权利？ | {{< lines 3 >}} |
| **3. "…given their continuous dependence on slavery?"**<br>“……鉴于其对奴隶制度的持续依赖？” | How did Athens (silver mine & domestic slaves), Sparta (8:1 helots), and/or Rome (33% enslaved population on latifundia & gladiators) depend on forced labor? Who else was excluded (women, non-citizens)?<br>雅典（银矿与家务奴隶）、斯巴达（8:1的希洛人）和/或罗马（占人口33%的庄园与角斗士奴隶）如何依赖强制劳动？还有谁被排斥在外？ | {{< lines 3 >}} |
:::

## Step 1.2: Focused Research Question & Initial Thesis Claim | 步骤 1.2：聚焦研究问题与初始中心论点（标准 B Strand i）

::: {.keep}
**1. {{< vocab "formulate" text="Formulate" zh=true >}} My Focused Research Question (focused on Greece, Rome, or both):**
我的聚焦研究问题（聚焦古希腊、古罗马或两者对比）：

{{< lines 3 >}}
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Model Thesis Statement Frame 中心论点句型模板（可参考改写）" icon=false}
*"Although Classical Mediterranean governance in **[Athens / the Roman Republic / Greece and Rome]** represented significant political and legal progress through **[citizen voting / checks and balances / the Twelve Tables]**, this progress was fundamentally limited because **[these societies continuously depended on institutional slavery and excluded the majority of the population from civic rights]**."*

**中文逻辑参考：** “尽管古典地中海文明（雅典/罗马共和国）通过（公民投票/权力制衡/《十二铜表法》）在政治与法律上取得了显著进步，但这种进步在根本上是有限的，因为这些社会持续依赖制度化的奴隶制，并将大多数人口排斥在公民权利之外。”
:::

::: {.keep}
**2. {{< vocab "formulate" text="Formulate" zh=true >}} My Initial Thesis Statement (Write in English):**
我的初始中心论点（请用英文撰写）：

{{< lines 4 >}}
:::

# Step 2 (Lessons 2 & 3): 1st Draft 步骤二（第2–3课时）：论文第一稿手写区

::: {.callout-tip title="Academic Sentence Starters & Transitions Bank 英文学术句型与过渡词工具箱" icon=false}
- **To Show Governance Progress 阐述治理与法律进步:** *"A major political breakthrough in [Athens/Rome] was…"* | *"According to [Source/Author], the Twelve Tables established…"* | *"Compared to earlier monarchies, this system empowered citizens by…"*
- **To Introduce the Contradiction of Slavery 转折引入奴隶制局限:** *"However, this civic progress was severely undermined by…"* | *"Despite these legal protections for citizens, [Athens/Rome] remained fundamentally dependent on…"* | *"From the perspective of an enslaved laborer / Spartan helot…"*
- **For Counter-Claim & Rebuttal (Advanced Path) 反方观点与批驳（进阶路径）:** *"Some historians might argue that judged by ancient standards, [democracy/republican law] was still revolutionary because…"* → *"Nevertheless, this argument overlooks the reality that freedom for citizens was directly financed by…"*
:::

## Step 2.1: Introduction Paragraph (Hook / Context + Thesis) | 步骤 2.1：引言段

**Checklist 写作核查:**

☐ Introduce Classical Mediterranean governance (Greece/Rome & optional baseline) 介绍古典地中海治理体系\
☐ Highlight the tension between citizen rights and slavery 点出公民权利与奴隶制的矛盾\
☐ End with your "To What Extent" Thesis Claim 以“在多大程度上”中心论点收尾

{{< lines 8 >}}

## Step 2.2 (Lesson 2): Legal Body Paragraph — Governance & Legal Progress | 步骤 2.2：治理与法律进步主体段

**Checklist 写作核查:**

☐ Clear Topic Sentence 清晰的主题句\
☐ {{< vocab "document" text="Documented" zh=true >}} evidence from library books/class texts (Athenian Assembly, Roman Republic checks & balances, Twelve Tables) 引用图书馆书籍或教材中的具体史实\
☐ {{< vocab "explain" text="Explain" zh=true >}} HOW this represented progress for citizens 解释这如何代表了公民权利与法治的进步

{{< lines 10 >}}

{{< pagebreak >}}

## Step 2.3 (Lesson 2): Slavery Body Paragraph — Continuous Dependence on Slavery & Exclusion | 步骤 2.3：奴隶制依赖与排斥主体段

**Checklist 写作核查:**

☐ Topic Sentence with contrast transition (e.g., *"However, despite these breakthroughs…"*) 带转折词的主题句\
☐ {{< vocab "document" text="Documented" zh=true >}} evidence of slavery (Athenian silver mines, Spartan helots 8:1, Roman 33% enslaved population/latifundia) & exclusion of women/non-citizens 引用奴隶制与社会排斥的具体证据\
☐ Criterion D Perspective {{< vocab "analyse" text="Analysis" zh=true >}} (citizen vs. enslaved person) 标准D多视角分析（对比公民与奴隶的处境）

{{< lines 10 >}}

{{< pagebreak >}}

## Step 2.4 (Lesson 3 — Advanced Pathway): Counter-Claim Paragraph & Rebuttal | 步骤 2.4：反方观点与批驳（进阶路径）

**Checklist 写作核查（进阶路径学生填写）:**

☐ {{< vocab "formulate" text="Formulate" zh=true >}} a strong Counter-Claim (e.g., *"Some historians argue that Classical democracy/law was still a revolutionary leap forward regardless of slavery…"*) 提出合理的反方历史观点\
☐ {{< vocab "justify" text="Justify" zh=true >}} your rebuttal with evidence showing why slavery cannot be separated from Classical governance 用史实证据有力批驳反方观点，维护你的中心论点

{{< lines 9 >}}

{{< pagebreak >}}

## Step 2.5 (Lesson 3): Conclusion Paragraph — {{< vocab "synthesize" text="Synthesis" zh=true >}} & Final "To What Extent" Judgment | 步骤 2.5：结论段

**Checklist 写作核查:**

☐ Restate your thesis in new words 用不同措辞重申中心论点\
☐ {{< vocab "evaluate" text="Evaluate" zh=true >}} and weigh civic/legal breakthroughs against the human cost of slavery 综合权衡政治法律成就与奴隶制的人道代价\
☐ Final reasoned judgment answering "To what extent?" 给出有理有据的最终历史评判

{{< lines 10 >}}

## Mingwan Bilingual Proficiency Rubric | 明湾学校学业水平双语评定量规（对接成绩报告系统）

| Band 等级 | Assessment 1: Criterion B Investigating 探究 (Booklet 手册) | Assessment 2: Criterion D Thinking Critically 批判性思维 | Assessment 2: Criterion C Communicating 沟通表达 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **EX**<br>Exceeding<br>卓越<br>*(90–100%)* | • Formulates a nuanced research question & thesis; refines claim to align with evidence. 提出深刻聚焦的研究问题与论点，并根据证据精准修正论点。<br>• Harvests rich, balanced evidence from both library books & class texts. 从图书馆书籍与课堂教材中收集丰富、均衡的史料证据。<br>• Thoroughly evaluates source value and limitations. 深入评估史料的适用性、价值与局限性。 | • Deeply analyzes both Classical governance progress and systemic dependence on slavery. 深入剖析古典治理进步与对奴隶制的系统性依赖。<br>• Evaluates citizen vs. enslaved perspectives and integrates a strong counter-claim/rebuttal (or baseline). 对比公民与奴隶视角，有力融入反方观点与批驳。<br>• Nuanced "to what extent" judgment. 得出深刻辩证的“在多大程度上”最终评判。 | • Exceptionally coherent, persuasive academic English essay. 英文论文逻辑极为严密、有说服力，学术语体规范。<br>• Sophisticated transitions linking arguments. 熟练运用高阶分析与对比过渡词。<br>• Accurate in-text citations and complete Works Cited list. 段内引用准确规范，参考文献列表完整。 |
| **PR**<br>Proficient<br>熟练达标<br>*(75–89%)* | • Clear research question & arguable thesis claim. 提出清晰的研究问题与可论证的中心论点。<br>• Completes action plan & alignment check within Lessons 1–3. 在第1–3课内完成行动计划与证据匹配核查。<br>• Relevant, accurate evidence from library books & class texts; completes source checklist. 从图书馆书籍与教材中收集准确相关的证据，认真完成自评表。 | • Clearly explains how Classical governance represented progress while remaining dependent on slavery. 清晰解释古典治理如何既代表进步又持续依赖奴隶制。<br>• Supports body paragraphs with specific historical evidence. 用具体史实支撑各主体段。<br>• Considers different perspectives and reaches a reasoned conclusion. 体现不同历史视角并得出合理结论。 | • Communicates clearly in formal academic English. 使用正式、清晰的学术英文进行表达。<br>• Follows structured essay blueprint (Intro, Body Paragraphs, Conclusion). 严格遵循论文结构蓝图。<br>• Cites library and class sources accurately. 准确标明所引用的书籍与教材来源。 |
| **DE**<br>Developing<br>发展阶段<br>*(60–74%)* | • Basic question or claim that only partially addresses the prompt. 研究问题或论点较为宽泛，仅部分回应题目。<br>• Action plan or checklist is partially completed. 行动计划或自评表仅部分完成。<br>• Relies mostly on one source or descriptive facts without checking claim alignment. 主要依赖单一史料或仅摘抄表面事实，未核查与论点的匹配度。 | • Describes Greek/Roman government or slavery, but analysis of "progress" is superficial. 仅描述希腊/罗马政体或奴隶制史实，对“进步程度”的分析停留在表面。<br>• Discusses governance and slavery separately without analyzing their contradiction. 将治理与奴隶制割裂叙述，缺乏内在矛盾分析与多视角思考。 | • Emerging clarity; some organizational or grammar issues. 表达基本达意，但存在一定篇章结构或语法问题。<br>• Uneven paragraph structure; limited transitions. 段落发展不均衡，过渡词较少。<br>• Incomplete citations or reference list. 史料引用或参考文献列表不完整。 |
| **EM**<br>Emerging<br>起步阶段<br>*(1–59%)* | • Unclear or missing research question/claim. 研究问题或中心论点缺失或混乱。<br>• Minimal source evidence recorded; checklist incomplete. 几乎未记录有效史料证据，自评表未完成。 | • Inaccurate or minimal explanation of governance and slavery. 对古典治理或奴隶制的理解不准确。<br>• Expresses unsupported personal opinions without historical evidence. 仅凭个人主观印象发表观点，缺乏史实依据。 | • Fragmented writing lacking paragraph structure. 文字零散，缺乏基本的段落组织。<br>• Minimal academic vocabulary; no source citations. 学术词汇匮乏，无任何史料引用。 |

::: {.content-visible when-profile="teacher"}
::: {.callout-note title="Teacher Guide: 6-Lesson Pacing & Dual Checkpoints"}
- **Lesson 1 (50 min) — Prompt, Thesis & Research:** Deconstruct prompt terms; model focused RQ & initial thesis frame; introduce curated library books & class texts. *Checkpoint:* Criterion B Check 1 (Steps 1.1–1.4 initiated).
- **Lesson 2 (50 min) — Steps 2.2 & 2.3 (Legal + Slavery Body ¶):** Mini-lesson on TEEL paragraph structure & embedding citations; finalize Criterion B Source Quality Checklist; draft Step 2.1 Intro, Step 2.2 Legal Body Paragraph (Governance Progress), and Step 2.3 Slavery Body Paragraph. *Checkpoint:* Criterion B Check 2 + Steps 2.1–2.3 drafted.
- **Lesson 3 (50 min) — Step 2.4 Counter-Claim & Step 2.5 Conclusion:** Final deadline to verify Criterion B Self-Assessment Checklist (ready for Assessment 1); Advanced Path drafts Step 2.4 (Counter-Claim & Rebuttal); all students draft Step 2.5 Conclusion. *Checkpoint:* Criterion B Finalized + Complete 1st Draft.
- **Lesson 4 (50 min) — Peer Audit + Drafting Buffer:** Track A (Ready Students) conducts structured Peer Audit in Step 3 (2 Glows, 2 Grows, Revision Plan); Track B (Drafting Students) finishes 1st Draft paragraphs followed by rapid check.
- **Lesson 5 (50 min) — 2nd Draft & Revisions:** Mini-lesson on upgrading `DE` to `PR`/`EX` (citizen vs. enslaved perspective analysis, analytical transitions, Works Cited formatting); write the 2nd Draft in Steps 4.1–4.5 and copy MLA drafts into Step 4.6.
- **Lesson 6 (50 min) — Type the Final Essay:** HOLD status academic integrity rules (students type directly from this annotated physical booklet; no generative AI or external websites). Collect the physical booklet alongside the final essay.
:::
:::
